Same $900K home. Etobicoke's tax difference?

Example only: $900,000 home, first-time buyer, refunds at the maximum.
1) Ontario land transfer tax: 0.5% of the first $55,000 ($275) + 1% of the next $195,000 ($1,950) + 1.5% of the next $150,000 ($2,250) + 2% of the remaining $500,000 ($10,000) = $14,475.
2) Less the Ontario first-time buyer refund of up to $4,000 = $10,475. That is the total outside Toronto.
3) Inside Toronto, a second municipal land transfer tax applies at the same rates up to $2 million: + $14,475 = $24,950.
4) Less the Toronto first-time buyer refund of up to $4,475 = $20,475.
Difference: $20,475 − $10,475 = $10,000.

Buyers must meet the refund conditions (for example, 18 or older, never owned a home anywhere in the world, and moving in within nine months). Legal fees, title insurance and adjustments are extra.

Sources: TRREB, land transfer tax rebate sheet (dated 09/26); Ratehub, Ontario Land Transfer Tax page, Oct 29, 2026. Please confirm with your lawyer.

frames.say: Nine hundred thousand dollars. Etobicoke's tax difference?
Step one. Ontario land transfer tax on nine hundred thousand: fourteen thousand, four hundred seventy-five dollars.
Step two. Minus the first-time buyer refund of four thousand. Outside Toronto, that's ten thousand, four hundred seventy-five.
Now the twist. Inside Toronto, a second tax applies at the same rates: fourteen thousand, four hundred seventy-five more.
Step four. Minus Toronto's refund of four thousand, four hundred seventy-five. Etobicoke lands at twenty thousand, four hundred seventy-five.
So the same home costs about ten thousand dollars more in land transfer tax in Etobicoke.

caption:
Oakville first home? Know your FHSA.

1) The First Home Savings Account (FHSA) has an annual limit of $8,000 and a lifetime limit of $40,000. 2) Unused room carries forward, up to $8,000 into the next year, and room starts building once your account is open. 3) Qualifying first-home withdrawals are tax-free, and contributions are generally tax deductible.

Source: Canada Revenue Agency, First Home Savings Account pages (modified February 2026). Eligibility rules apply.

caption:
Mississauga buyers: the fridge may not stay.

Myth: whatever you saw at the viewing comes with the home. Fact: 1) Fixtures, like light fixtures, are usually included unless the agreement excludes them. 2) Chattels, like a fridge or washer, are included only if the agreement lists them. 3) So ask your realtor to list every item you expect to stay before you make an offer.

Lenders differ, so ask yours for its exact list.
